findings.title: Front->Top rename stops at the XML field; the C# still says Front
findings.detail: Only the XML field was renamed to shieldTopTexPath. The cache field shieldFrontGraphic (MountExtension.cs:72), the property ShieldFrontGraphic (MountExtension.cs:77), the `front` local at Building_WeaponMount.cs:444 and DrawShield's doc comment ('optional front layer') still use the old name. Rename the property to ShieldTopGraphic, along with its field and its one call site, so the next reader doesn't take Front and Top for two different layers.

findings.title: shieldFrontTexPath was a public XML field; renaming it breaks any outside patch that sets it
findings.detail: Any XML patch or add-on def that still sets <shieldFrontTexPath> will now get RimWorld's 'doesn't correspond to any field' XML error, and its top layer won't draw. Nothing in the indexed corpus uses the old name (search_source found nothing), so this is a changelog line, not a code change.
